recommendations.title: Enhance Ad Targeting to Improve CTR
recommendations.whats_happening: The CTR is low at 4%, indicating that although traffic is coming in, it may not be from the right audience or lack intent.
what_you_should_do: Refine targeting criteria to narrow focus on first-time investors with high intent
In Google Ads, adjust audience settings to include demographic and behavioral targeting
Test different ad copies and creatives that resonate with first-time investors to improve engagement
recommendations.why_this_matters: Improving CTR can lead to higher quality traffic, ultimately increasing conversions and revenue from the campaign.
recommendations.expected_impact: An estimated 15-25% improvement in CTR, leading to more engaged potential customers.

recommendations.title: Evaluate and Optimize Landing Page
recommendations.whats_happening: Missing data on landing page views makes it hard to evaluate traffic effectiveness and engagement post-click.
what_you_should_do: First, obtain landing page view data by implementing tracking on the website
Once data is acquired, analyze bounce rates and engagement metrics on the landing page
Adjust the landing page to ensure it aligns with ad messaging and optimizes user experience
recommendations.why_this_matters: Understanding landing page performance helps assess the quality of traffic and opportunities to improve conversion rates.
recommendations.expected_impact: Enhanced landing page engagement could lead to higher conversions, potentially increasing CVR above 10%.

recommendations.title: Monitor CPC Trends Alongside CTR
recommendations.whats_happening: The CPC is stable at $1.26, but the low CTR raises concerns about the efficiency of ad spend with the current engagement levels.
what_you_should_do: Implement weekly monitoring of CPC and CTR changes in Google Ads
If CPC rises without improving CTR, consider pausing or adjusting underperforming ads
Test lower bids on specific keywords to evaluate impact on CTR without drastically increasing costs
recommendations.why_this_matters: Keeping CPC in check while improving CTR ensures that ad spend remains efficient and maximizing returns.
recommendations.expected_impact: Potentially reduce CPC by around $0.20 while improving CTR metrics.

recommendations.title: Test Different Ad Creatives
recommendations.whats_happening: Current ad creatives are likely not resonating well with the audience, contributing to low CTR and potential misalignment with the offering.
what_you_should_do: Develop and rotate at least three new ad creatives focused on personal loan benefits for first-time investors
In Google Ads, run A/B tests comparing new creatives to existing ones for performance measurement
Use insights from A/B tests to understand what messaging drives higher engagement
recommendations.why_this_matters: Refreshing ad creatives can attract better quality traffic, ultimately improving engagement and driving more traffic to the funnel.
recommendations.expected_impact: Expected to improve CTR by 5-10% if more relevant creatives are introduced.
